ground_truth: I do. Absolutely I do. And you know, one of the things I think is important to note is that citizens of my state want to see our southern border secure. If I were someone with a dreamer in my family, or if my church group was working with a family that had a dreamer, I would be very upset with the Democrat leadership right now. Because those dreamers have been offered a three-year legalization. And that is something they have sought for years. And there is a way to solve this problem.
